ENGLISH LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only a describing word
   D. Only an action

2. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. Where is the Library
   D. where is the library

3. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. blue

4. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.

5. When practising Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing: Open ended Compositions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing: Open ended Compositions.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing: Open ended Compositions.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing: Open ended Compositions.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing: Open ended Compositions.

   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

8. When practising Listening and Speaking Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking Listening Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking Listening Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking Listening Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking Listening Comprehension.

9. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns.

10. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. No full stops

11. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. went
   C. goes
   D. goed

12. When practising Speaking Fluency: pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Speaking Fluency: pronunciation.
